profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a publicly traded company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker UBER. Its own site describes the Uber platform and apps as tools for earning, eating, commuting, getting a ride, and simplifying business travel.

The company says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing them as a key part of the future of movement. It says it is partnering with industry leaders and using a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The company's litigation record shows 281 cases in California.
